description:
Zibai ( Chinese : 兹白 Zībái ) is a playable Geo character in Genshin Impact .

She was once an Angel who governed the civilization of Lang-Gan , worshipped as the God of Soil and Grain before Lang-Gan's destruction, eventually becoming one of the Eight Adepts . During the Lantern Rite celebration following the events of Archon Quest Song of the Welkin Moon : Act VIII - True Moon , the Traveler and Zhongli successfully reunited the three fragments of her divided soul, restoring her to her original form.

Upon obtaining Zibai, the Gadget That Which Has Lost Its Power may be obtained through the character menu. After reaching Friendship Level 6 and completing World Quest Adeptus's Gift , it is transformed into Jadelight Canopy .
role_summary: Zibai is a Geo DMG dealer who enables her teammates to trigger Lunar-Crystallize reactions and who deals Lunar-Crystallize DMG directly. After casting her Elemental Skill , Zibai enters Lunar Phase Shift. While in this state, Zibai can accumulate the special resource, Phase Shift Radiance, through different methods. Zibai can consume Phase Shift Radiance to unleash the special Elemental Skill, Spirit Steed's Stride, dealing Geo DMG and Lunar-Crystallize DMG to opponents. Upon unleashing her Elemental Burst , Zibai can also deal Geo DMG and Lunar-Crystallize DMG to opponents.

talents.name: Golden Blade's Petaled Touch
talents.description: Normal Attack Performs up to 4 rapid strikes. Charged Attack Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes. Plunging Attack Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

talents.name: Heaven and Earth Made Manifest
talents.description: Summoning a shadow of her former powers, she switches to the Lunar Phase Shift Lunar Phase Shift After using the Elemental Skill Heaven and Earth Made Manifest, Zibai will change to this mode. This mode lasts at most 15s and has the following properties: Normal and Charged Attacks are converted into Geo DMG that cannot be overridden by other infusions. The Elemental Skill Heaven and Earth Made Manifest will also be converted to the Elemental Skill Spirit Steed's Stride: When Zibai has at least 70 Phase Shift Radiance, she can consume 70 Phase Shift Radiance to unleash Spirit Steed's Stride and cause two instances of Geo DMG. The second instance will be considered Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG. A maximum of 100 Phase Shift Radiance points can be accrued, and Zibai can accumulate them in the following ways: She gains 10 points every second she is in the Lunar Phase Shift mode. She gains 5 points when hitting an opponent with her Normal Attacks. She can gain Phase Shift Radiance points in this way once every 0.5s. talents.name: Layered Peaks Pierce the Clouds
talents.description: Other Geo party members increase Zibai's DEF by 15% each. Hydro party members increase her Elemental Mastery by 60 each.

talents.name: The Coursing Sun and Moon
talents.description: When a party member triggers a Hydro Crystallize reaction, it will be converted into the Lunar-Crystallize reaction, with every 100 DEF that Zibai has increasing Lunar-Crystallize's Base DMG by 0.7%, up to a maximum of 14%. Additionally, when Zibai is in the party, the party's Moonsign will increase by 1 level.

talents.name: Moonlit Flower Forest
talents.description: At night (18:00 – 06:00), when not in combat, restore 1 Elemental Energy to Zibai every 2 seconds. This effect does not work in Domains , Trounce Domains , or the Spiral Abyss .
